scope: Historical six-deck stage-1 continuation. No current Standard or playing-strength claim.

calibration.trainable: value_head only; actor and encoder bitwise frozen
calibration.target: real terminal learner-seat outcome +1/-1/0; no teacher values
calibration.admission: Only frames from naturally terminal games. First bounded retained learner frames per complete episode, capped globally at 128 for fitting. Independent heldout games require natural completion.

ppo.optimizer_batch: One full admitted two-episode batch per epoch with framewise gradient accumulation. At most four optimizer steps per update. No minibatch reshuffling.
ppo.value_target: Terminal Monte Carlo outcome MSE; GAE is a separate advantage estimator using frozen OLD student values.
ppo.forced_choices: Excluded from policy loss, entropy and policy advantage normalization; retained for value fitting. Native auto-forced transitions remain environment work.
ppo.kl_measure: Mean sampled-action nonnegative approximate KL exp(logratio)-1-logratio on genuine learner choices, measured across the full frozen batch after each epoch.

budget_accounting: Carry actual stage-1 wall and learner-choice counters into this invocation. Stage3+4 includes source validation, startup, collection, optimization and checkpoint work. The original 7200-second/100000-choice arm cap never resets. Stage1 allocation1800, stage3 allocation1200, stage4 allocation2400, independent evaluation allocation1800. No extra teacher queries, GPU or league work.
evaluation: Separate root-owned fixed seeded evaluation of stage1 actor, stage3 pre-RL actor and stage4 endpoint against the same fixed uniform legal opponent. Calibration MSE and PPO diagnostics do not establish playing strength.
checkpoint_invariants: Stage1 actor copy, stage3 pre-RL and stage4 endpoint each have immutable model, optimizer/RNG and source/input lineage receipts. Only checkpoints with a completed JSON receipt are usable. A fault or timeout during an optimizer update prohibits saving that partial update as a usable endpoint.
runtime: Linux CPU1 nice19, one torch thread, deterministic float32 eager CPU. Exact pinned historical libfastenc, schema and decks. No teacher model load, no league, no live play.
